nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in the abstract Token contract.
Mapping of holder balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of spending allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Token name string initialized to "Pizza".
Token decimals, set to 18.
Token symbol, set to "PZ".
Concrete total supply, 10000*10**18, assigned in the constructor.
Library function multiplying two uint256 values and asserting no overflow.
Library function dividing two uint256 values, asserting the divisor is non-zero.
Library function subtracting two uint256 values, asserting no underflow.
Library function adding two uint256 values and asserting no overflow.
Public transfer that validates balances and updates sender/recipient balances.
Public transferFrom that validates balances and allowance then updates balances and allowance.
View function returning the balance of the given owner.
Sets an allowance for a spender; requires zero value when a non-zero allowance already exists.
View function returning the remaining allowance between owner and spender.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts plain Ether transfers.
Constructor assigning the whole supply to the deployer and emitting Transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner and constructor beneficiary.
Raw multiplication a * b executed before the overflow assert, the classic overflow sink.
Raw addition _balances[_to] + _value inside a require in transfer, an overflow check sink.
Raw addition _balances[_to] + _value inside a require in transferFrom, an overflow check sink.
Raw addition a + b executed before the overflow assert in safeAdd.
Destination address parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value of transfer.
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter _to of transferFrom.
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom.
Owner address parameter _owner of balanceOf.
Owner address parameter _owner of allowance.
Spender address parameter _spender of allowance.
Spender address parameter _spender of approve.
Allowance amount parameter _value of approve.
First multiplicand a of safeMul.
Second multiplicand b of safeMul.
Minuend a of safeSub.
Subtrahend b of safeSub.
First addend a of safeAdd.
Second addend b of safeAdd.
Local product c computed in safeMul.
Local quotient c computed in safeDiv.
Local sum c computed in safeAdd.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the source of the balance lookup and debit in transfer.
msg.sender is used to read and reduce the spender allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key written in approve.
The constructor mints the whole supply to the deployer msg.sender.
transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the _balances mapping for both parties.
balanceOf returns the value stored in _balances.
The constructor initializes _balances for the deployer.
transferFrom reads and decreases the _allowed allowance.
approve reads and overwrites the _allowed entry.
allowance returns the value stored in _allowed.
The constructor uses totalSupply as the minted amount.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication a * b before asserting, an overflow sink.
safeAdd performs the raw addition a + b before asserting, an overflow sink.
transfer evaluates _balances[_to] + _value, a raw addition overflow check.
transferFrom evaluates _balances[_to] + _value, a raw addition overflow check.
The constructor flow writes the initial balance state before any other interaction.
The _to parameter is validated against address(0) and used as the credit key.
The _value parameter bounds the amount moved in transfer.
_value is added to the recipient balance in the raw overflow require.
The _from parameter is the debited account and allowance owner.
The _to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value credited to _to is part of the raw overflow require.
The _value parameter bounds the transferred amount and allowance decrease.
_value participates in the raw addition overflow check of transferFrom.
_owner is the lookup key returned by balanceOf.
_owner keys the _allowed lookup in allowance.
_spender keys the _allowed lookup in allowance.
_spender is the grantee key written by approve.
_value is stored as the new allowance value.
Operand a feeds the raw multiplication inside safeMul.
Operand b feeds the raw multiplication inside safeMul.
Minuend a is consumed by safeSub.
Subtrahend b is consumed by safeSub and asserted against a.
Addend a feeds the raw addition inside safeAdd.
Addend b feeds the raw addition inside safeAdd.
Local product c is the result value returned by safeMul.
Local quotient c is the result value returned by safeDiv.
Local sum c is the result value returned by safeAdd.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination argument exists only to serve the transfer balance update.
Amount argument exists only to bound the transfer arithmetic.
Source argument exists only to serve the transferFrom debit and allowance.
Destination argument exists only to serve the transferFrom credit.
Amount argument exists only to bound transferFrom balance and allowance math.
Owner argument is only used as the balance mapping key.
Owner argument is only used as the allowance mapping key.
Spender argument is only used as the allowance mapping key.
Spender argument is only used as the allowance grantee key.
Value argument is only used as the stored allowance.
Multiplicand a is consumed directly by the raw multiplication sink.
Multiplicand b is consumed directly by the raw multiplication sink.
Minuend a is consumed by safeSub.
Subtrahend b is consumed by safeSub.
Addend a is consumed directly by the raw addition sink.
Addend b is consumed directly by the raw addition sink.
Temporary product c is only a carrier of the safeMul return value.
Temporary quotient c is only a carrier of the safeDiv return value.
Temporary sum c is only a carrier of the safeAdd return value.
